deviations_from_adr: T-0729.assessment.md is an ASSESSMENT (design phase, three options evaluated), not a ratified per-part ADR -- this task follows the founder-facing recommendation of section 4/5 (variant (в)+(б), (в) already delivered by T-0744) and mini-specs the (б) part locally as docs/tasks/T-0745.spec.md. No ADR-level literal deviation.

Scope discipline: the assessment's variant-(б) UX list (§3) names THREE items -- (1) annotate every option in the substitute picker with 'who holds the role', (2) an inline warning banner on selection, (3) surface force_tier2. This task's own instructions (orchestrator prompt) named only (2)+(3) as the deliverable -- (1) is a nice-to-have enhancement (per-option annotation requires threading the holder set into the picker's option list, a materially bigger UI change) that was NOT explicitly requested and is deliberately left out (proportionality, coder role §5). Documented in T-0745.spec.md §1 as an explicit, intentional scope cut, not an oversight.

The new read GET /api/rights/intents/substitution-coverage was not pre-specified anywhere -- it was designed during this task (T-0745.spec.md §2) after confirming neither GET /api/org/tenant-state (no role_assignment data at all) nor the existing GET /api/rights/tenant-state (self-scope privacy-filters assignments to caller-only, which would produce FALSE NEGATIVES for an ordinary employee's self-absence warning) can honestly answer 'does this stand-in hold role X' for every caller. The new endpoint is a minimal, additive READ (no schema/table change, reuses the exact role_assignment predicate already used twice in this file for tier determination, plus T-0744's substituteProvidesCoverage verbatim) -- flagged here for visibility since it was not literally named in the task brief, even though the brief's own investigation questions ("нужен ли новый read-эндпоинт") anticipated exactly this decision point.

design_summary.warning_client_or_server: Hybrid, decisive signal from the SERVER: GET /api/rights/intents/substitution-coverage computes provides_coverage by reusing T-0744's substituteProvidesCoverage over a live role_assignment holder query; the client (useSubstitutionCoverage hook) only renders that answer via the pure substituteCoverageWarning(...) function. A purely client-side check was rejected -- the client has no reliable holder data (see deviations above); a purely post-submit server advisory field was rejected -- the warning must be visible BEFORE submit, while the force_tier2 checkbox choice can still be made.
design_summary.force_tier2_exposed: Yes, in BOTH SubstituteForm and SelfAbsenceForm, as a checkbox labelled honestly in Russian ('Выдать замещающему собственный временный доступ сразу') with a hint describing exactly what it does ('ограниченный временный грант (не шире прав замещаемой роли) немедленно -- независимо от того, есть ли другие держатели роли') -- no 'force_tier2' or 'Tier-N' jargon anywhere in visible text (regression-locked in ra-intents.test.jsx). The checkbox pipes straight into the EXISTING, already-tested force_tier2 body param (rights-intents.ts:744 registerSubstitute, :1231 registerSelfAbsence) -- zero new server mint logic.
design_summary.consistency_with_T0720_T0731: The warning text was written to the SAME no-jargon, honest-about-current-mechanics discipline those two tasks established for substituteResultMessage/selfAbsenceResultMessage (no promise of automatic escalation; states plainly what the system does, not what it might do). It additionally reflects T-0744's owner-claim fix (merged into base before this task): the warning correctly says an orphaned task falls to the tenant owner ('владельцу тенанта' -- the SAME term already used elsewhere in the product, e.g. screen-org.jsx/screen-users.jsx), not to the stand-in -- this is new, T-0745-specific honesty (T-0720/T-0731 predate T-0744 and could not have said this).
design_summary.T0744_predicate_reuse: Literal reuse, not re-derivation: the new server route imports substituteProvidesCoverage from src/core/substitution.ts (unchanged, untouched module) and calls it exactly as computeEffectivePool does internally -- substituteProvidesCoverage({ ttlGrantId: null, substituteEmployeeId }, roleHolderSet). The holder-set query mirrors the SAME role_assignment predicate (confirmed_by IS NOT NULL, in-window) already used twice in this file (registerSubstitute/registerSelfAbsence's poolRows queries) for tier determination -- so the pre-submit warning can never disagree with what the write path itself will decide.

live_proof_plan: Stand is currently offline -- this is a PLAN, not an executed run (mirrors T-0720/T-0731's live_proof_plan shape).
1. Seed/pick two employees A (holds role R) and B (does NOT hold role R) in the same tenant, plus a role R with A as ONE confirmed holder.
2. Log in as an admin/owner, open Rights -> Бытовые операции прав (/rights/intents) -> 'Подмена' (SubstituteForm). Pick any absent employee, role R, and B as 'Замещает'.

3. Expected: within ~1 request-roundtrip after picking B, an inline warning banner appears: 'Замещающий сейчас не держит «R» -- пока роль покрыта другими держателями, подмена сработает в рамках его собственных прав. Если все держатели станут недоступны, задачи роли уйдут не к нему, а владельцу тенанта (роль будет считаться незаполненной). Чтобы доступ получил именно этот сотрудник -- включите ниже «выдать собственный временный доступ».' A checkbox 'Выдать замещающему собственный временный доступ сразу' is visible below it, unchecked by default.
4. Switch 'Замещает' to A instead (who DOES hold R) -- the warning banner must disappear (checkbox stays visible).

5. Switch back to B, tick the checkbox, fill remaining required fields, submit. Expected: 201, response tier: 2, and (server invariant, unchanged by this task) a TTL'd delegable=false grant minted for B -- confirm via GET /api/rights/tenant-state or DB that B's inbox now shows role-R tasks immediately (same mechanism force_tier2 already exercises in ci/checks/db/rights-intents.db.test.ts FF-SUB-3).

6. Repeat steps 2-5 on 'Я в отпуске' (SelfAbsenceForm) as employee A declaring their own absence and nominating B -- same warning text (mutatis mutandis, this form has no 'Отсутствует' picker), same checkbox, same tier-2 outcome when checked.

7. Regression: open both forms WITHOUT touching the substitute picker at all -- neither SubstitutionCoverageHint block (warning OR checkbox) renders (substituteId is empty), matching the pre-T-0745 form layout exactly for an untouched form.

8. Regression: confirm GET /api/rights/intents/substitution-coverage with a role_id the caller's tenant does NOT own returns 200 with holder_count: 0 / provides_coverage: false (never a cross-tenant leak) -- resolveTenant derives tenant strictly from the caller's own employee row, the query is tenant-scoped.
